    if group.length > 0 then
        write_line("  {name} = {group}")

si

parse_url(url: string) is

        show("domain", m.groups["host"].value)

        fi

        show("path", m.groups["path"].value)
        show("query", m.groups["query"].value)
        show("fragment", m.groups["fragment"].value)
    fi
si

let urls = [
    "foo://example.com:8042/over/there?name=ferret#nose",
    "urn:example:animal:ferret:nose",
    "jdbc:mysql://test_user:ouupppssss@localhost:3306/sakila"

    "ftp://ftp.is.co.za/rfc/rfc1808.txt",
